prompts.name: kk_menhera_real_zoomout
prompts.prompt: Image 1 is a close-up photo of a phone screen. Zoom out: make a new photo of the same scene with the camera pulled back, so the whole smartphone is visible, held in a person's hand in a dark room, slightly tilted, photographed by another phone like image 2. The phone screen must show exactly the content of image 1, unchanged: same purple heart background, same bubbles, same Korean text and line breaks, same avatars, same emojis, same number of bubbles (five bubbles, the last one ends with 보여줄게; do not add or repeat any bubble). Above the bubbles show only a plain dark purple area; below the last bubble show only dark purple background. Keep the real-photo feel: faint crack line on the glass, dust, slight moire, soft light reflection, phone camera noise. Dark phone bezel visible around the screen. No other text, no app icons, no watermark.
